(Left) 3 1 2 6 9 8 1 3 4 1 6 9 5 1 1 5 9 9 4 2 7 7 8 3 9 8 8 (Right)

Odd → Odd → Even

**Odd numbers satisfying the condition:**

→ 1 in (3 1 2)

→ 3 in (1 3 4)

→ 9 in (9 9 4)

→ 7 in (7 7 8)

→ 9 in (3 9 8)

Therefore, there are **5** such odd numbers.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the husband of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’ and

P % Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

How is J related to Z if ‘J # S + R & T % Z’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74c9165e9d1057b2d362d255fa83304c30b6412afd8e6dd4eb65323272fa0ac1.png] 

**Given:**

P + Q → P is the mother of Q

P # Q → P is the husband of Q

P & Q → P is the sister of Q

P % Q → P is the father of Q

**Expression:**

J # S + R & T % Z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef37b0a4d39493f0153a842ec5a7d3474dc1a8b6528275d403fd8b8d0d6ce555.png] 

**Family chain:**

T is the father of Z.

R is the sister of T, so R is Z's aunt.

S is the mother of R and T.

J is the husband of S.

Therefore, J is the father of T.

Since T is the father of Z, J becomes Z's grandfather.

Hence, J is **Father's father** of Z.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: Z ranked 12th from the bottom and 56th from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Z is 56th from the top and 12th from the bottom.

**Formula:**

Total students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom − 1

**Calculation:**

= 56 + 12 − 1

= 68 − 1

= 67

Hence, the total number of students in the class is **67**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: Piyush starts from Point A and drives 54 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 56 km, turns right and drives 59 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 61 km. questions.solution:

2. Turns right and drives 56 km

So, Point P is 5 km west of Point A.

To reach Point A again, Piyush must travel **5 km towards the east**.
